questions.topic: Reading a limit from a graph
questions.learningObjective: Read an approached value from a graph
questions.stem: A factory report plots machine output versus time; as time approaches 4 hours, the plotted output approaches 18 units. What does this describe?

options.text: The output at 4 hours is exactly 18 units
The output exceeds 18 units after 4 hours
The limit of output as time approaches 4 is 18
The graph has no limit at 4 hours
options.misconception: mistakes a hole for no limit

questions.explanation: A limit describes the value approached, not necessarily the value at the point. The tempting choice confuses the approached value with the actual output at four hours.

questions.stem: A report uses m(x)=x+1 for x<3. What is the left-hand limit at 3?
questions.explanation: From the left, x+1 approaches 4. The tempting error uses x=3 and gets 4 anyway.
